findings.message: Loop bound changed from i < start+len(pageRows) to i <= start+len(pageRows), iterating one index past the end of the page slice. rows[i] will read an extra row (the first row of the next page) or panic with index out of range when the page is at the end of rows.
findings.suggestion: Revert to i < start+len(pageRows) (or iterate over pageRows directly).
